title: Good morning
subtitle: No beta token entered.
headline: Enter your beta token
body: This test build of Sidekick needs a beta token before it connects to your phone. The person who invited you to the beta sends it — paste it below or open the file. The token is checked on this Mac; nothing is sent anywhere.
gateMessage: This token wasn’t issued for this copy of Sidekick, or part of it changed on the way — its signature doesn’t match. Check that all of it was copied, or ask the person who invited you to the beta for a new one.
